viewing_check: Weigh by eye vs a coin; check for 'S/L', 'D/G' or 'lined' stamps on the discs and bars; check the bars are not hollow or dented; engraved 'WJ' monogram is wear-prone. Solid 3-4 g pairs sold A$220-320 in the last year; lined ones A$20-50. Bid shows none yet, next bid $120 (about A$146 with premium). If solid this is a safe flip, if lined it loses.
